article_title: The Shwegugyi Pagoda Inscription, Pagan, 1141 A.D.
source_text: Sri namo buddhāya: / I. / Yo kämapankagahaṇaṁ taritum nisamma / Nalam tilokam akhilaṁ varadhamma-bhāņuṁ / Tassesanāya bhuvi māpayi suddhibuddhi / Buddhaṁ name tamasamaṁ saha dhamma sanghaṁ. / Ayam hi bhaddako kappo pañcabuddha-virājito
